author: Stahly
description:
Witness the start of my new Warhammer 40,000 and Horus Heresy terrain collection, a Sector Munitorum built around the terrain pieces from the 40k starter set and Killzone Volkus. In this post, I'll show you the first finished models and share all the paint recipes and techniques I used, in case you fancy recreating them yourself. And yes, I've snuck some classic 2nd edition blue-grey in there too ;)

The post Building a Sector Munitorum: my new 40k terrain collection begins appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Building a Sector Munitorum: my new 40k terrain collection begins
